findings.detail: FX02 treated normalized token UNIT_USD as non-USD even though the source fair-value schedule is dollar-denominated.

rationale: The reviewed rows are flagged only because fair_value_currency is UNIT_USD. Raw source schedule table 233 labels the relevant column as Fair Value and shows dollar-sign fair values, and table 243 ties the schedule total to $565,360,825. UNIT_USD is therefore a normalized USD unit token, not evidence of a non-USD fair-value currency. The FX02 check is over-scoped/misclassifying the USD token.
